answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.036, below every category's range (quantized 0.096+, fine-tuned 0.086+, system-prompted 0.113+), and the layer-2 spike is 0.1, nowhere near the 31.7+ a system prompt produces. That rules out system-prompted and quantized. Median first divergence is 1 and edit distance 0.777, which are closer to system-prompted than fine-tuned. But the added refusals (9), disclaimers up from 7.8% to 26.6%, and short replies up to 28% point to a weight change from fine-tuning. Effective rank 3.82 and direction consistency 0.608 fit fine-tuned better than system-prompted (rank 2.70-2.75). Logit and activation changes (KL 0.454, final L2 0.554, cosine 0.837) are larger than any category's range, so this is probably a stronger fine-tune than the reference ones. Activation growth from a small layer-1 difference also fits fine-tuning. Quantized is ruled out by the large drift and behavior shifts.
